name: stars
label: Number of stars
description: Number of star icons to display.

name: size
label: Size
description: The size of a star can be small, medium, or large. A good size allows stars to be noticeable but not overwhelming given their context.

name: ariaLabel
label: ARIA label
description: The ARIA label is the text a screen reader says out loud to identify the component to users. A good label is simple and clear.
